method.description: Read frozen monthly full EGS intermediate candidate surfaces only and evaluate the preregistered redesigned Tier1+Tier2 hard filters plus relative-strength, volume-expansion, and breakout all-pass trigger before any outcome / benchmark calculation.
hard_filters: tier must be Tier1 or Tier2.
list_status must equal L where present.
has_crash_veto and is_lock must be false where present.
Do not filter by steady-lane Tier1-only, entry_flag, chasing_high, or overheat_flag before trigger evaluation.
method.validation_command: Bundled Python read-only preflight over result/a_short/backtest/generated/_intermediate/egs_full_*.csv, applying the preregistered hard filters / signal conditions without outcome returns, benchmark excess, provider fetch, EGS rerun, or cohort regeneration.

evaluation_result.interpretation: The redesigned full-universe preflight passes the preregistered event-count gate with 134 valid signal events across frozen Tier1+Tier2 full EGS intermediate cohorts. This is only an input-integrity / event-count pass; it does not compute outcome returns, benchmark excess, drawdown, concentration, alpha, or ship-gate evidence.

diagnostic_notes: All 24 frozen full EGS intermediate cohort files from 20240131 through 20251231 were present.
No required input columns were missing and no rows were dropped for unparseable required preregistered input fields.
The eligible hard-filter universe is Tier1 plus Tier2 only; Other-tier rows were not counted as valid hard-filter events.
Within hard-filter rows, 1589 rows passed the full relative_strength family, 1291 rows passed volume_expansion, 511 rows passed breakout_quality, and 134 rows passed all three families.
The 134 valid signal events are sufficient only to justify a separate reviewed outcome / benchmark-excess slice under the unchanged preregistration.
SR-DATA-003 benchmark-open input remains unresolved, so no outcome return or benchmark excess run is authorized by this preflight artifact.
This artifact did not run A-EGS, regenerate cohorts, fetch provider data, produce signal_events.csv / monthly_stats.csv, or modify any runner.
